CustomField.description: This field calculates how long the visitor was at the service desk in minutes.
CustomField.formula:
/* Date Time fields are resulting in full days. So multiple by 24 hour and 60 minutes per hour to get the minutes */
(Completed_Date_And_Time__c - Called_To_Service_Desk_Date_And_Time__c) * 24 * 60
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How many minutes was the visitor at the service desk.
CustomField.label: At The Service Desk Duration (Minutes)
